**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The Deerskin/HDI agreement contains no MFN obligation burdening us:

- **Fee provisions (§§ 3.1–3.3)** set a fixed economic formula (30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month, with monthly payment and quarterly reconciliation). There is no obligation to give HDI terms no less favourable than those extended to any third party, no disclosure duty, and no right to match a third-party offer.
- **§ 4.2 Termination Payment** is a fixed formula, not a best-terms mechanic.
- **§ 1.8** is the document's only "no less favorably" comparison, and it runs *to our benefit*: HDI must promote the Site and Deerskin Products no less favourably than its own catalog titles, at HDI's cost. Per the detection guidance, a Vendor-granted favourable-terms obligation is marked compliant and not redlined.
- **§ 6.1** (Company will not participate in similar projects; HDI's exclusive right to the "Deerskin" brand web site) is brand/sourcing exclusivity, not a best-terms or right-to-match mechanic. It is a genuine customer-side concern, but it belongs under the exclusivity rule and I have not flagged it here so the same commercial term is not flagged twice.

No redline proposed.
